description: A condition demands its argument be non-throwing, and non-throwing is one color over the whole surface — so consuming what a parameter's call hands back needs no floor of its own, and the demand is answered at the call site by the argument's iterator as well as by its call. A generator that throws after its first yield, a plain function that hands one on, and one whose return type erases the protocol to `any` are all reported there — the last because the demand is read off the parameter's type, which the owner's body was checked against, and never off the argument, which is free to say less.

Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`, or pass something non-throwing for `make`.
